purpose: Repair only TAP transport for frozen v094g after repeated HTTP 504 responses occurred before any science source_calib result was successfully cached. Preserve the v094g deterministic sample, queried fields, source-identity rules, control-recovery rules, thresholds, guards, and interpretive boundary unchanged.

science_source_calib.cache_key: SHA256 of exact ordered source_id set

working_data_boundary: Machine-only work caches may contain sampled source IDs, Gaia IDs, and calibrated positions because they are necessary for reproducible aggregate source-identity testing. They are not candidate adjudication products, are not printed to the console, and must not be copied into result outputs. Raw TAP responses are retained under work/ for provenance.
interpretive_boundary: v094g1 is an operational continuation of frozen v094g. It may identify aggregate evidence that v094c rows are dominated by persistent Gaia-associated sources, control astrometric displacement, source-specific control non-recovery, crowding, artifacts, or plate-response differences. It does not establish any individual source as transient or non-transient, does not adjudicate a candidate, and does not define or execute a corrected Branch A/B/C population.
next_stop: Interpret v094g1 Gaia/control-recovery mechanism evidence before corrected-population design, candidate inspection, or registration.
